note: Status, effective date and summary are supported. Two issues. (1) official_identifier 'Public Act 103-0804' is not in any stored text; a human or an ilga.gov copy should confirm it. (2) The only official source for date and status is gov-pritzker-newsroom.prezly.com, listed in known_hosts. It is the State of Illinois Newsroom page and carries the Governor's press contact, but it sits on Prezly, a commercial platform, and it is the reason the level moves from C to A. A human should decide whether that host counts as official. A search suggests the IDHR notice rules proposed on 15 May 2026 may have been withdrawn (one secondary source only); the notes' 'as of April 2026' phrasing is still true.
